method.afterBootstrap: Four slots where affordable; alternating refill/bourbon; unassigned odd lot age18/even lot24
method.assignment: retail: none; mixed: odd lot only; wholesale: any explicitly assigned; v081-single: accept a fresh one-cask offer when available
method.terms: Nearest offered age to alternating18/24 goal, lower age tie-break; accept alternating repeat proposals, decline others
method.judgments: Taste, end, wait/last; funds bottle its selected unassigned cask; cancel assigned target only as last recourse
method.sampling: Six-month intervals and all ordinary judgments/manual bottlings
method.information: Current public age, quoted cost, offered fixed terms, price tier, tasting; no future chemistry, optimum or hidden quality used
method.time: 60 extraction frames/shared month, not instant completed distillation; zero-time choices are not a human play duration estimate
